impact: Weaker crypto prices cut into HOOD's crypto trading revenue, already down 21% m/m in October, and weigh on COIN; watch HOOD at Monday's open.
summary: Bitcoin traded around $65,400 early Sunday, Nov. 15 (Coinbase, OKX), down about 5% in 24 hours and roughly 14% over the past week. That extends Saturday's slide to about $67,200, its lowest since August, with crypto fear gauges at extreme fear as bets on a December Fed hike rise.
title: Bitcoin drops to ~$65K Sunday, down ~14% on the week
